퀘스트 설명 (영문 원문)

In Lith Harbor, you meet a heavily-bearded crewmember of The Victoria called Teo. He says he has some Weird Medicine but he isn't willing to give it up for free. Instead he says he'll trade it for a sparkling rock. He seems like he knows Maya pretty well, yet he still wants a favor first, knowing how sick Maya is? Creep. Anyway, to get the sparkling rock, you should head to Perion and talk to Sophia, the daughter of the owner of the General Store there.

Fortunately, Sophia knows where to get some. She says to have a chat with Manji, who's somewhere around Perion.

Well, now you just have to do it trade it with Teo in Lith Harbor.

Inside a tree tunnel near Ellinia, you find Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son. He says the red book is off limits, but he seems to be starving. In the end, you make a deal. If you get him 20 Lupin Bananas, Rina's Unagi Special, and some Fresh Milk, he will hand over the book. According to Ronnie, you can find Rina in Henesys and the fresh milk from Rowen the fairy, in Ellinia.
